review: skipped 701.28c: the reason claimed a convert of a non-double-faced permanent is unreachable, but a Clone copying Arcee, Sharpshooter carries the convert instruction while being a single-faced card; removed the skip and added scenario 701.28c-1

skipped.reason: no Forge card has a convert instruction whose other face is an instant or sorcery; see the skip of 701.27d

scenarios.title: Converting turns a permanent to its other face under the transform rules

setup.notes: Arcee, Sharpshooter is a 2/2 first-strike artifact creature; its ability reads 'Convert Arcee'. Converted it is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe, a 2/2 Vehicle with living metal. B holds Unsummon and does not use it unless stated.

decisions: A activates Arcee's ability, paying {1} with Mountain and removing one +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: a_turn
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe with one +1/+1 counter; it is a Vehicle that is also a creature during A's turn, so it is a 3/3 creature.

variants.label: b_turn
variants.delta: It is B's turn (B's main phase 1) and A activates the ability at instant speed after B passes priority.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe with one +1/+1 counter; it is a Vehicle and not a creature during B's turn.

variants.label: target_gone
variants.delta: In response to the ability, B casts Unsummon (tapping Island) on Grizzly Bears, returning it to B's hand.
variants.expected: The ability's only target is gone, so it is removed from the stack without resolving: no damage is dealt and Arcee stays Arcee, Sharpshooter with one +1/+1 counter. Grizzly Bears is in B's hand.

scenarios.title: A convert instruction on a permanent that is not a double-faced card does nothing

setup.notes: Clone entered as a copy of Arcee, Sharpshooter, so it is a legendary 2/2 first-strike artifact creature named Arcee, Sharpshooter with its convert ability; the original Arcee then went to A's graveyard under the legend rule. Clone has one +1/+1 counter (a 3/3).

decisions: A activates the copied ability of Clone, paying {1} with Mountain and removing its +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: single_faced_copy
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Clone does not convert: it is still a copy of Arcee, Sharpshooter, a 2/2 artifact creature with no counters.

variants.label: double_faced_card
variants.delta: The permanent is the card Arcee, Sharpshooter itself (with one +1/+1 counter) instead of a Clone copying it, and A's graveyard is empty.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee converts and is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe, a 2/2 Vehicle that is a creature during A's turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Card.canTransform requires the card itself to be transformable, so SetState skips a Clone whose copiable values come from a double-faced card.

scenarios.title: Converting does not trigger 'turned face up' abilities

setup.notes: Aven Farseer is a 1/1 flyer with no counters. Daru Lancer is a face-down 2/2 creature.

decisions: A activates Arcee's ability, paying {1} with a Forest and removing the +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and Arcee converts.

variants.label: convert
variants.expected: Arcee is Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe. Aven Farseer's turned-face-up trigger does not fire; Aven Farseer is a 1/1 with no counters. Daru Lancer is still face down.

variants.label: turn_face_up
variants.delta: Instead of activating Arcee, A turns Daru Lancer face up by paying {2}{W}{W} with all four lands.
variants.expected: Daru Lancer is face up. Aven Farseer's trigger fires: Aven Farseer has one +1/+1 counter and is 2/2. Arcee is still Arcee, Sharpshooter.

scenarios.title: A convert instruction from an ability is ignored if the permanent converted since the ability went on the stack
decisions: A activates Arcee's ability, paying {1} with a Mountain and removing one +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Hill Giant.
Holding priority, A activates the ability a second time, paying {1} with the other Mountain and removing the last +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Hill Giant.
Both players pass; the second ability resolves, then both pass again and the first ability resolves.

variants.label: two_activations
variants.expected: Hill Giant has 2 damage marked. The second ability's resolution converts Arcee to Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe; the first ability's convert is ignored and Arcee stays Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe (a Vehicle with no counters).

variants.label: one_activation
variants.delta: A activates the ability once only (one counter removed); the second activation does not happen.
variants.expected: Hill Giant has 1 damage marked. Arcee converts once, to Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe, with one +1/+1 counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge stores the host's transform timestamp on the stack instance (StoredTransform) and compares it when SetState resolves.

scenarios.title: A permanent that can't transform can't convert

setup.notes: Bound by Moonsilver: enchanted creature can't attack, block, or transform.

decisions: A activates Arcee's ability, paying {1} with Mountain and removing the +1/+1 counter (X=1), targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: enchanted
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee does not convert: it stays Arcee, Sharpshooter (a 2/2 creature with no counters), still enchanted by Bound by Moonsilver.

variants.label: unenchanted
variants.delta: Bound by Moonsilver is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked. Arcee converts to Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe.
